title: post-alerting-v2-action-policies-id-update-api-key
description: Update an action policy API key

id.description: The ID of the action policy. Copy it from the response when you create a policy, fetch one policy, or fetch the policy list. You can't change it after creation. Avoid reusing a deleted policy's ID: the new policy inherits its execution history and throttling state. IDs appear in URLs and logs, so don't include sensitive data.
